(async()=>{const a=T.$gameParty.battleMembers()[0];const P=()=>[a.atk,a.def,a.mat,a.mdf,a.agi];const out=[];for(let s=1;s<=7;s++){const sc=new T.Scene_Equip(a);sc.slotWin.index=s-1;sc.refreshCandidates();const cands=sc.candidates.filter(c=>c);const rec={slot:s,name:T.$dataSystem.equipTypes[s],ok:true,msgs:[]};if(!cands.length){rec.ok=false;rec.msgs.push('无候选');out.push(rec);continue;}const it=cands[0];const old=a.equipAt(s);const before=P();a.changeEquip(s,it.id);const after=P();const delta=after.map((v,i)=>v-before[i]);const oldExp=old?[old.params[2],old.params[3],old.params[4],old.params[5],old.params[6]]:[0,0,0,0,0];const expDelta=it.params.slice(2,7).map((v,i)=>v-oldExp[i]);rec.delta=delta.join(',');rec.exp=expDelta.join(',');rec.ok=delta.every((v,i)=>v===expDelta[i]);if(!rec.ok)rec.msgs.push('delta!=expected');a.changeEquip(s,0);out.push(rec);}a.changeEquip(5,50);a.changeEquip(6,122);a.changeEquip(7,65);await T.saveGame(3);const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('tndt_save_3'));const eqSaved=saved.actorSnapshots.find(x=>x.id===a.actorId).equips;a.changeEquip(5,0);a.changeEquip(6,0);a.changeEquip(7,0);await T.loadGame(3);const match=JSON.stringify(eqSaved)===JSON.stringify(T.getActor(a.actorId)._equips);return JSON.stringify({slots:out,saveLoadMatch:match});})()
